content.comment_body: I would like to understand how to use the [product_name] memory card, and how to read or write data with it.

The [product_name] program modules can be used to duplicate switching programs and to protect intellectual property. This feature is available on [product_name] [version_no], where standard SD cards can be utilized.

Thank you [user_name], To clarify, I am asking about using the [product_name] memory for situations where I have a counter and would like to clear it and store its value. I want to save up to 10 counter values. Is it possible to use the memory card for data logging like on [product_name] [version_no]? Or is there another method available? My module is [version_no]. best regards [user_name]
Hello, Are you referring to retentive memory for data storage, or are you trying to simply transfer counter data?
Every time I clear my counter, I want to save the value so it can be monitored later. I need to store up to 10 values.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are interested in using the [product_name] memory card for more than just program transfer and protection; they want to log counter values and retrieve them when needed. The available documentation mainly covers program duplication, which creates uncertainty around whether user data can be stored and accessed on the memory card of [product_name] modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] memory card to enable data logging, specifically the ability to save and retrieve multiple counter values, similar to features found in other controllers such as [product_name] [version_no].
